A gentle note while Folio is open after your bedtime. It only appears in the three hours after it, and your page is always kept.
Your page is saved. A good night\'s sleep makes tomorrow\'s reading better.
A warm, amber screen for the evening. It takes out the blue light that keeps you awake, so reading before bed is easier on your sleep.
It eases in and out gently, and covers your books, manga and the rest of Folio. Pop-up sheets and dialogs are not tinted.
Folio never saves what you search for. These settings also clear what browsing leaves behind.

Removes manga you opened but did not add, and the cached pages and covers from sources. Your library and downloads stay.
Also sign out of source websites. Sites with a Cloudflare check will ask again.
Folio stays offline unless you turn on manga sources. Your books, notes and music never leave this device.

%1$s is code from whoever published it, and it runs inside Folio with the same access Folio has. Only accept it if you trust the repository it came from. Its signing key:

Reading from the web is off

Turn it on to save web pages for offline reading, follow RSS feeds and follow web novels. Folio connects to a site only when you save, add or check something there; pages are saved with their pictures, and no cookies are kept.
The readable part of the page is kept — text, headings and pictures — and becomes a book in your library. You can also share a link to Folio from your browser.
RSS and Atom feeds work, and so does a site’s own address when it advertises a feed. Feeds are checked only when you open them.

Give the address of the first chapter you want. Folio saves it and the next ten as one book, following each chapter’s Next link, and adds new chapters when you check. Works on sites that show chapters as plain pages; sites that load text by script or need a login will not work.
